notes.title: Olympics Thomas More: Complete the game in “athletic mode” and get the reward.
notes.content:
[b]PRESENTATION[/b]

From Zoozobra we are very happy about the launch of the game. We always wanted to make video games; We already tried many years ago with a couple of prototypes written in Fénix code for the GP2X portable game console, but now, finally, we have achieved one of our dreams; our first finished video game will be released on July 9: More. The Eternal Utopia, the visual novel that parodies the figure of Thomas More to take his heritage seriously.

It is for this reason that we would like to propose that you participate in a challenge: The [b]Thomas More Olympics[/b], a contest in which the player must play in "attentive mode" or "athletic" so to speak, if he wants to guess the philosophical references - to thinkers of different sign– and literary –including winks and homages to different aspects of More's own work, of which we are now celebrating the 505th anniversary– that appear in the visual novel, in order to reach the goal of the game, which is also make you reflect.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40747101/25ca7cc2358dda594356f2bbffab43fe15d29397.png[/img]

[b]AWARD: ZOOZOBRA PACK.[/b]

Players who manage to reach the good ending of the story and locate the literary and philosophical references that appear in it, will obtain a prize consisting of:

    • The Tánatos trap (2020): the university dystopia by Víctor Atobas, a novel in which the utopian impulse is also expressed.
    • The 3 special issues of Zoozobra Magazine: enjoy the texts of different collaborators, as well as the wonderful designs of Sara Barreiro.
    • Wallpaper More. The Eternal Utopia in high definition.
      

[b]DATES[/b]

From July 9 to December 31, 2021.


[b]HOW TO PARTICIPATE IN THE THOMAS MORE OLYMPICS?[/b]

- Beat the game and get to the good end of the story: the ever-renewed hope! The Morian promise that still lives on today!
- Write down the literary and philosophical references that you have found.
- Review the game on the game's Steam page and tell us what you think of the proposal.
- Send to mailbox2 [at] zoozobra.com a screenshot showing that you have passed the game, as well as the list of literary and philosophical references.
- The Zoozobra team will respond to you by sending you the Zoozobra pack in digital format.
